reason: Both correctly conclude the long Eco 40-60 time is normal and advise against returning the machine, but Conversation 2 resolves it in one turn with an accurate explanation of why eco programmes run long and cool (directly addressing the homeowner's stated unknowns), names the TimeManager button and Cottons 40 as faster alternatives, and gives clear criteria for what a real fault would look like. Conversation 1 needlessly asks the homeowner to unplug the machine, inspect the door seal and run a 60°C test wash before it had any reason to suspect a heating issue, and only reaches the correct reassurance after the homeowner volunteered the Cottons 40 timing. Neither recommends a part or escalation, so the decisive difference is Conversation 2's efficiency and more complete, honest explanation.
